name: Foreman Bradiggan

abilities.name: Magic Bolt
abilities.description: A basic range attack dealing high magical damage.

abilities.name: Soul Toss
abilities.description: Foreman Bradiggan forms an orb of soul magic and tosses it at you, exploding on impact, dealing massive magical damage. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Soul Charge
abilities.description: Foreman Bradiggan lurches forward before dashing ahead at full speed, indicated by a long rectangular AoE, dealing very high physical damage. Harrowing Haunters and Skeletal Flame Shapers are summoned in its wake.

abilities.name: Soul Quake
abilities.description: Foreman Bradiggan overloads itself with soul magic before releasing it in the form of four magical tornadoes going outward from his position, indicated by large traveling AoEs, dealing very high magical damage and staggering you.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: At 60%/30% health, Foreman Bradiggan teleports away, summons a powerful flesh colossus and enters its body to hide from you. You must slay the colossus in order to make Foreman Bradiggan vulnerable to damage again.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: You've come for a job … I don't tolerate tardiness.
dialogue.trigger: As you approach the area, he will appear from the sky

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: Get a move on! I said get!

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: I'll hound you from dawn to dinner bell, loafer.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: Stubborn arses, I'll drive you like mules then.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: I have my eye on you. I'm always watching.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: Move, or you can work the plagueyards instead!

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: I can sniff out a dawdler no matter where you linger.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Braddigan
dialogue.line: Don't raise your hand to me, whelps!

summary: Foreman Bradiggan is a spectral wraith who can be found at the lumber yard of Shipwright's Regret. He acts as the first boss of the dungeon.
